p19_commands.identity: Idempotency-Key is the UUID request_id; the server trace request_id is different. One immutable key per operation intent. Body order, original canonical document version, actor, auth session, warehouse and trusted organization dimensions are bound.
p19_commands.versions: CREATE has no If-Match. SCAN/POST require the original canonical document If-Match, never a staging draft version. Do not mix X-Draft headers or the linked RECORD contract. A stale version returns 412 VERSION_CONFLICT. Fresh commands on already POSTED documents cannot claim historical movements as their own success.
p19_commands.scan_body: This opt-in scanner protocol accepts exactly line_id, actual code_value (nonempty, at most 200 characters), and quantity. The canonical owner resolves the target. Do not send item_id/container_id overrides or synthesize raw input from IDs. Existing ID-only legacy requests remain a separate protocol, not eligible for these new receipts.
p19_commands.scan_evidence: The canonical SCAN response adds scan_entry_id: the UUID of the entry inserted by that operation. The receipt verifies this exact entry against parent, line, quantity, target and nullable scan_event_id. An event ID is never synthesized. result.scan.id_source is component_issue_items.id; event_status is NOT_RECORDED when the owner has no event, otherwise SOURCE_EVENT. Missing or mismatched entry identity rolls back the write and stays UNKNOWN; an older NULL-event row is never used as proof. This does not fabricate raw-code/timeline evidence for P20.
p19_commands.response: data.outcome and data.receipt.result; CREATE/SCAN/POST only succeed after verifying canonical persisted results in the same transaction as the receipt. Follow result.current_detail_url for CURRENT state, not another CREATE.
p19_commands.journal: p19_component_command_receipts; dedicated to P19, not P03, P09 or generic idempotency cleanup
p19_commands.no_repair: The migration only creates an empty receipt table. It does not repair, seed, restore or change business records. No live migration or deployment was performed by this handoff.

outcomes.SUCCEEDED: Historical receipt of this exact operation, not current Web/case/document state.
outcomes.FAILED: Confirmed 4xx rejection after transaction rollback; inspect original response_status/error_code. Do not silently clamp, rewrite the list or change key/version.
outcomes.UNKNOWN: Missing/foreign/other-session receipt, in-flight claim, lost worker, 5xx or ambiguous commit. Receipt is null. Check only; no lease timeout, takeover, automatic replay or new-key replacement. DRAFT/404/current POSTED does not resolve it.

p19_commands.retention: No purge/TTL on command receipts. Rollback preserves a nonempty table; operator recovery for stuck UNKNOWN requires separate investigation and approval.
p19_commands.privacy: No body, raw scan code or free-text note stored in command receipts. Payload fingerprint is an HMAC. Reads/replays revalidate active account, session, warehouse, rights, persisted case owner and source organization scope. Foreign session reads return UNKNOWN without disclosing the receipt.
p19_commands.timestamps: Receipt recorded_at is stored and serialized as UTC ISO-8601, independently of application/database timezone; it is a server timestamp saved transactionally, not a database WAL commit instant. Canonical posted_at/occurred_at are preserved from their source rows, not synthesized. They are distinct from meta.observed_at. DEV must still verify canonical source timezone behavior on the deployed tier.
p19_commands.disable_behavior: Disabling new command execution leaves authorized GET recovery available. This setting does not enable any FE screen or authorize live test writes.
p19_commands.compatibility: Legacy requests without the header and without a known P19 journal key keep their existing canonical or linked RECORD behavior. Omitting the header for a known journal key fails closed with 409. Old in-flight operations cannot be retroactively assigned new receipts. Do not change protocol midway to recover them.

scanner_panels.resolve: Existing POST /api/v1/mini-app/warranty-component-issues/resolve-code (and existing mini-app component-issue-documents alias), with the command contract header; read-only and usable without the command execution flag.
scanner_panels.case: Send exact warranty_case_id. Persisted warehouse ownership and current case status are rechecked; cached open-case flags cannot authorize a closed case.
scanner_panels.confirmation: Require resolved===true, eligible_for_issue===true and case_allows_issue===true, with matching context. meta.p19_scanner.can_confirm_local is local confirmation only, not a canonical scan or stock reservation. Fresh checks can only narrow the original owner eligibility decision.
scanner_panels.quantity: ITEM available_qty remains null, not zero. BOX available_qty is freshly read for that container/SKU; null, invalid or fractional source quantities remain unknown. Zero is a confirmed empty quantity, not a missing response. Never clamp rejected input.
scanner_panels.reasons: meta.p19_scanner.reason_kind is always UNKNOWN when resolved is not true; otherwise UNIT or BOX follows the resolved target type. HTTP 200 by itself proves neither eligibility nor command success.
scanner_panels.freshness: Resolver is a read, not a lock held while the panel is open; every subsequent owner write performs its normal version, case-state and stock validation again.

unchanged_owner_boundaries.P04_P03: Save the complete ordered batch first. Use exact owner draft/version/key/body and RECORD receipt/reconcile. Business ID differs from staging ID. P19 canonical receipts are not interchangeable with these receipts.
unchanged_owner_boundaries.P05: Keep source version separate from draft version; retain X-Draft headers, source-linked SAVE/RECORD and original key. No standalone or recipient override, no guessed P05 If-Match.
unchanged_owner_boundaries.P19_linked: p19-component-issue-linked-v1 SAVE/RECORD with P03 receipts remains a separate existing protocol; it is not CREATE/SCAN/POST recovery.
unchanged_owner_boundaries.P20_P09: Use existing immutable links, posted movement/scan evidence, REMOVED counts and source timestamps. Closed cases may still be read with correct rights. Do not close, reopen, Post or recreate while opening a panel or checking results.
unchanged_owner_boundaries.FE: Cancel/ignore stale callbacks using request identity and session/context generation. Preserve scoped private checkpoints; no blanket storage wipe on logout. Empty/error/denied/UNKNOWN states are separate. Do not label code count, quantity and attempts as one number.

release_gates: Approve separate P19 canonical command protocol and deploy its empty schema before enabling writes; full P24 activation remains OFF.
